rules: 1. All taskcards must be COMPLETE before bundle is built
2. Final IV must pass (IV_PASS) — run AFTER all taskcards close
3. Build bundle — this captures the IV_PASS result inside the bundle
4. Compute bundle SHA-256 and size from the frozen bundle
5. Write sprint-closeout.json with the frozen bundle's SHA, size, entries
6. Write external .sha256 sidecar with frozen bundle SHA
7. NEVER rebuild closeout or bundle after sidecar is written
8. Commit chore: reference sidecar in commit message
sidecar_protocol_v11.key_invariant: The bundle must be built AFTER the final IV_PASS run. The closeout must be written AFTER the bundle is frozen. The sidecar must be written AFTER the closeout is written. None of these steps can be reordered.

process_change.adversarial_review_protocol_update: Final adversarial review must explicitly open bundle and verify: bundled iv-results.json verdict == closeout.iv.verdict. This was missing from Wave 14 AR-09.
process_change.iv_process_update: IV must be run LAST (after all taskcards close), THEN bundle built. Not: build bundle, close taskcards, re-run IV.
